PASELEC EM04 PRO – High-Performance Electric Dirt Bike

Unleash Power. Conquer Every Trail.

Experience powerful off-road riding with the PASELEC EM04 PRO Electric Dirt Bike. Built for experienced riders and off-road enthusiasts, this high-performance electric motorcycle combines a 5500W peak mid-drive motor, a top speed of up to 50 mph, and a maximum range of up to 60 miles.

With hydraulic suspension, responsive braking, and three selectable speed modes, the EM04 PRO is designed to deliver an exciting and controlled riding experience across challenging off-road terrain.

5500W Peak Mid-Drive Motor – Built for Powerful Performance

Take on challenging trails with a high-performance 5500W peak mid-drive motor delivering up to 220 N·m of torque.

The mid-drive design provides strong power delivery for acceleration, hill climbing, and off-road riding.

Up to 60 Miles of Riding Range

Go farther with the 60V 27Ah removable lithium battery. Designed for extended off-road adventures, the EM04 PRO offers a maximum advertised range of up to 60 miles under suitable riding conditions.

The integrated Battery Management System (BMS) monitors battery operation, while the removable design makes charging more convenient.

Hydraulic Suspension for Rough Terrain

The front and rear hydraulic suspension system helps absorb bumps and impacts when riding across uneven terrain.

Whether you're navigating rocky trails, dirt paths, or rough off-road surfaces, the suspension system is designed to improve comfort and handling.

Three Selectable Speed Modes

Adjust your riding experience with three selectable speed modes.

Choose a mode that suits your experience, riding conditions, and terrain.

Front and Rear Hydraulic Disc Brakes

The EM04 PRO features front and rear hydraulic disc brakes with an electronic braking assistance system (EABS).

This braking configuration is designed to provide responsive stopping performance and improved braking control during off-road riding.

Multifunction LCD Display

Stay informed with the multifunction LCD dashboard, which provides access to essential riding information, including:

Current Speed

Speed Mode

Battery Level

Mileage

Headlight Status

Brake Indicators

Adjustable LED Headlight

The adjustable LED headlight provides illumination for riding in low-light conditions. Its adjustable design allows riders to direct the beam according to their needs.

Key Ignition and Removable Battery

The key-operated ignition system adds a convenient access-control feature, while the lockable battery compartment helps secure the removable battery.

Charge the battery while installed in the motorcycle or remove it for separate charging.

Durable High-Carbon Steel Frame

Built with a high-carbon steel frame, the EM04 PRO is designed for demanding off-road riding.

Its 11.2-inch minimum ground clearance provides space for navigating uneven terrain, while the motorcycle-style construction offers a solid platform for recreational riding.

Technical Specifications

Who Is the EM04 PRO For?

The PASELEC EM04 PRO is best suited for experienced riders seeking a high-performance electric dirt bike for recreational off-road riding.

Its powerful motor, high top speed, and motorcycle-style controls make it more appropriate for riders with prior experience than for first-time riders.

Important Riding Information: Intended for off-road use. Do not assume this vehicle is street legal. Check applicable local regulations and land-use restrictions before riding. Always wear appropriate protective equipment. Maximum speed and range vary with rider weight, terrain, temperature, riding style, and other conditions. Riders under 18 should only operate the vehicle where legally permitted and with appropriate adult supervision.
